description: A light wooden tabletop is in front of you with a small clear plastic jar on the right and a mound of white slime near the center. The left hand presses and smooths the slime from the left edge toward the center while the right hand pokes and drags the top surface with two fingers, then both hands press down and push the slime slightly to the right before the left hand pulls it back and the right hand lifts and folds a small section, continuing the kneading motion.
